name: ScanUrl
description: Submit a URL to PolySwarm's engine marketplace for a fresh multi-engine verdict. Spends a scan and creates account activity; reuses an existing result unless force_rescan is set.

url.description: The URL to scan. Submitted to PolySwarm's engine marketplace, which spends a scan unless a matching result already exists.

scan_config.description: How long PolySwarm waits for engines to answer before returning a verdict: 'default' is fastest; 'more-time' and 'most-time' wait longer so more engines can finish, at the cost of a slower playbook run.

detect_threshold.description: How many malicious engine detections activate the detected branch. Default of 1 flags on any single detection.

force_rescan.description: Skip the check for an existing result and submit a new scan. This spends a scan even when PolySwarm already has a result for this URL, so leave it off unless you need a fresh verdict.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the scanned URL artifact

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

malicious_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the URL as malicious

benign_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the URL as benign

total_count.description: Total number of engines that responded

cached.description: Whether the result came from an existing scan instead of a new submission

engine_name.description: Name of the engine that returned this verdict

author_name.description: Name of the party that authored the engine

verdict.description: What the engine answered: true for malicious, false for benign, null when the engine abstained, which counts as neither

outputs.not detected: PolySwarm has scanned this artifact and no engine detected it
